feeds.title: Ethan Kind
feeds.description: Ethan Kind writes and published extensively on Alexander Technique. He teaches musicians, athletes, and computer operators how to stop hurting themselves, by showing them how to use their bodies with ease and coordination. He brings a unique perspective to his work, having been a musician and athlete all of his life.

feeds.title: Body Learning Blog Alexander Technique
feeds.description: Exploring the Alexander Technique and the Discoveries of F. Matthias Alexander with Robert Rickover of Lincoln, Nebraska and Toronto, Canada.

feeds.title: Carolyn Simon Blog
feeds.description: Stay poised, calm and pain-free with the Alexander Technique - the world-renowned approach to improving posture, co-ordination and freedom of movement, and escaping from back-ache, tension and stress. Carolyn Simon qualified from a STAT approved training course in 1995, and is certified as an Alexander Teacher both by the Society of Teachers of the Alexander Technique and Alexander Teaching International.

feeds.title: Alexander Stories Blog
feeds.description: Alexander Stories blog is about the Alexander Technique where Sheila Christie writes about body use and movement. Relieve back pain and neck pain and improve posture, balance and mobility with Alexander Technique teacher Sheila Christie in Islington, North London.

feeds.title: The Art of Freedom Alexander Technique
feeds.description: Mind-body skills and Alexander Technique for musicians with Jennifer Roig-Francoli. Relieve pain, tension, anxiety; improve posture and performance. The Art of Freedom, by Jennifer Roig-Francolí, offers effective strategies to address persistent musicians' issues, such as pain, tension, and anxiety, from the inside out.

feeds.title: Walk In Balance Blog
feeds.description: Walk in Balance Alexander Technique Center offers help for back pain, muscle strain, and injuries. It is dedicated to helping people eliminate all self-generated stress and tension.

feeds.title: Alexander Studies Online Blog
feeds.description: Alexander Studies Online is a volunteer-based organization. It is directed by an editorial board and runs in collaboration with the STAT Research Group. Our vision is to enable a greater understanding of the Alexander Technique through disciplined inquiry. We support a global community of people interested in advancing their understanding of the Alexander Technique.

feeds.title: Alexander Technique and Somatic Experiencing Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Michaela. Practicing Alexander principles has helped me deal with many physical issues, especially as I grow older and want to remain active. I enjoy teaching adolescents to become more knowledgeable of their growing and changing bodies while facing new challenges in their lives.

feeds.title: Alexander Technique Lewes Blog
feeds.description: My name's Kate Minogue. I'm an Alexander Technique teacher living and working in Lewes. I work to help my students un-learn, change their habits, and throw away what they think they know.

feeds.title: Inbalance - Alexander Technique Blog
feeds.description: Through In Balance Alexander Technique, AmSAT Certified Teacher Eve Bernfeld helps people bring self-care out of the periphery of their lives and teaches skills to do it in the moment. She uses the Alexander Technique to remember herself even when pulled in a million directions and loves to teach all kinds of people (like performers, people in pain and expectant mamas) to do the same!

feeds.title: Freedom in Motion: Alexander Technique -- Back and Neck Pain, Stress Relief, Mindfulness Blog
feeds.description: Using a unique, hands on approach, certified Movement Efficiency Expert Jeremy Cohn will give you a personal guide to your movement and actual experience in how to change it for the better. It helps to achieve fuller, healthier lives by unlocking untapped potential held back by excess tension and stress, create long term, lasting solutions and community of people seeking self actualization.

feeds.title: Jenny Goodwin Alexander Technique Blog
feeds.description: Jenny is a member of the Society of Teachers of the Alexander Technique (STAT). Tension-related problems can literally 'get you down'. Learning the Alexander Technique makes it possible to move and think with less tension/more energy. I hope in my teaching to offer a calm and supportive space to allow you to learn.

feeds.title: Alexander Technique with Tully Hall Blog
feeds.description: The Alexander Technique is a way to organize yourself for optimal functioning. You learn to let go of unnecessary tension (un-squash yourself!) so you can integrate your posture, movement, and breathing in all your activities. Read the blog to know more.

feeds.title: N. Brooke Lieb, Alexander Technique Teacher Blog
feeds.description: N. Brooke Lieb Nationally Certified Teacher of the Alexander Technique Director of Teacher Training, The American Center for the Alexander Technique You can let the pain go: Let me teach you what every Body should know.

feeds.title: Body and Posture Blog
feeds.description: This blog gives tips to improve posture as well as alleviate back pain through Alexander Technique.

feeds.title: Bill Plake Music Alexander Technique and Music
feeds.description: Clearer Thinking For Better Performance. The posts are pointed specifically at the principles of the Alexander Technique as they pertain to playing music (including injury prevention, self-care, practice habits, etc.)

feeds.title: Clare Maxwell Movement and Breathing Coach Blog
feeds.description: Get Movement and Breathing Coaching with The Alexander Technique Teacher Clare Maxwell. She enjoys helping people with chronic tension re-discover joy and ease in movement using the Alexander Technique and her own movement practices rooted in her many years as a dancer and choreographer.

feeds.title: Hilary King's Blog
feeds.description: Read more about the Alexander Technique including observations on more general topics that interest me, and notifications about my teaching timetable.

feeds.title: Way Opens Center
feeds.description: Way Opens Center Blog helps you in movingiInto Mindfulness Through Alexander Technique, Qigong, and Insight Meditation in Philadelphia and Yardley, PA.

feeds.title: Centre for the Alexander Technique Pete's Blog
feeds.description: Pete's Blog offers Alexander Technique Lessons, Post-graduate work for Alexander Teachers, service for the business and the professions, Ribeaux Consulting.

feeds.title: Rita Rivera
feeds.description: Rita Rivera blogs about The Alexander Technique, Restorative Movement & Dance and The MELT Method in this blog. Improve your postural integrity through awareness, balance, integration.

feeds.title: Applying Alexander Technique with Jim Crosthwaite
feeds.description: Improve health, wellbeing and productivity with Jim Crosthwaite, privately or in your workplace. Learn self-observation and body mapping skills; how to change bad habits; how to better coordinate actions like typing and reaching; and many tips based on Alexander Technique.

feeds.title: The Alexander Technique Guild of Ohio
feeds.description: The Alexander Technique Guild of Ohio is a network of certified Alexander Technique teachers dedicated to sharing the benefits of The F.M. Alexander Technique for health, productivity and well-being.

feeds.title: Off The Mat Yoga Alexander Technique
feeds.description: Posts about Alexander Technique written by Cecile Raynor. She is a Mind/Body Movement Expert based on over 25 years experience teaching a mind/body modality called the Alexander Technique, the best kept secret of famous performers and Olympic Athletes.

feeds.title: Body Project Alexander Technique with Elyse Shafarman
feeds.description: Elyse is honored to help people of all ages and vocations find ease and comfort in their bodies. Discover the Alexander Technique to reduce stress, refine movement and open creative channels in performance.

feeds.title: Body Intelligence Alexander Technique
feeds.description: This blog contains posts about Alexander Technique written by Imogen Ragone, empowering women in business to function at their best—for the sake of their business, their well-being, and their life.

feeds.title: The Actor's Secret Blog
feeds.description: The Actor's Secret has The Alexander Technique principle to improve ease of movement through neuromuscular reeducation. As a highly respected senior Alexander Technique educator, Betsy Polatin pioneered a four-year Alexander curriculum for the acting conservatory program at Boston University's College of Fine Arts, where she is a Master Lecturer.

feeds.title: Alexander Technique with Jessica
feeds.description: The Habit Specialist Alexander Technique & Coaching with Jessica. Develop the necessary skill to relinquish counterproductive patterns and acquire fresh and rewarding habits. Depending on your goals, we may work on breath, stress reduction or performance skills.

feeds.title: Mark Josefsberg Alexander Technique NYC Alexander Technique Posts
feeds.description: Miscellaneous posts and articles about the Alexander Technique by Mark Josefsberg. Alexander Technique lessons improve your posture, ease neck tension, and provide back pain relief.

feeds.title: Victoria Stanham - Alexander Technique
feeds.description: As an Alexander Technique teacher (STAT certified), Pilates Method instructor and avid independent scholar of the mind-body relationship, she teaches all types and levels of athletes and fitness enthusiasts to make the most of their physical and mental resources in their chosen movement sphere.

feeds.title: Alexander Technique Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to one of the most seasoned Alexander Technique websites online today. Alexander Technique can help with back pain, headaches, stress, sciatica, and many muscular pains. It will give you confidence in public speaking.

feeds.title: Allyna Steinberg - Blog
feeds.description: Allyna Steinberg, Certified Alexander Technique Teacher, has over 15 years of experience and completed a 1600 hour teacher training at the Balance Arts Center. Allyna teachers in New York City and Stone Ridge, Mid-Hudson Valley, New York.

feeds.title: Bristol Alexander Technique - Claire Coveney MSTAT, Alexander Technique Teacher
feeds.description: The Alexander Technique will help you to increase poise, freedom, fluidity and presence. Rediscover balance and poise, use appropriate tension and let go of habits that can cause stress, pain or under-performance.

feeds.title: Learn The Alexander Technique Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Bridget Barr. I am a member of the Society for Teachers of the Alexander Technique and I'm committed to working within their ethical and professional standards. My quest to learn about the Alexander Technique is the most enduring so far and, I am sure, one that will stay with me always.

feeds.title: Alexander Technique with Jane Staggs Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jane Staggs. I have been teaching Alexander Technique lessons in Cambridge for over 30 years. I'm also interested in chair design and its role in the development of poor posture and back pain and campaigned for a more sensible seat design. On my blog, read articles on Alexander Technique, Backpain, Pilates, and more.

feeds.title: Movement and Posture Blog
feeds.description: Pete qualified as an Alexander Technique Teacher in 2007 and has taught privately, given workshops and masterclasses. Read his blog to improve your posture, movement, performance, and health.

feeds.title: Meagan Johnson Studio Blog
feeds.description: With a life-long interest in the intersection of artistry, education, and well-being, Meagan Johnson is a certified teacher of the Alexander Technique. Meagan guides you to make connections between body awareness, mindfulness, attention, and creativity. Dig deeper into ideas that inspire your learning process. Read reflections from Meagan about the intersection of AT, voice, and the world on her blog.

feeds.title: Alexander Technique Seaford Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Natalie Gibellini. I am a qualified Alexander Technique Teacher, who trained at the Brighton Alexander Technique College. The Technique teachings became a way of life and such a valuable skill set that I decided to train as an Alexander Technique teacher and leave my job in NHS Wellbeing services so I could share these benefits with other people.

feeds.title: Alexander Technique in London
feeds.description: Susanna Scouller is an Alexander Technique Teacher that loves her job. She finds joy in helping people to help themselves. On her blog, Susanna shares her guidance, tips, notes, stories, and more on and about Alexander Technique.

feeds.title: Bristol Alexander Studio Blog
feeds.description: Alexander Technique for all in central Bristol. My name is Henry and I'm an Alexander Technique teacher based in Bristol, England. I have over a decade's experience working with hundreds of clients of all backgrounds. I'm a member of The Society of Teachers of the Alexander Technique (STAT) and am registered with the Complementary and Natural Healthcare Council (CNHC).

feeds.title: NY Alexander Technique Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Rebecca Poole, I offer private and group Alexander lessons tailored to your unique health, wellness, and self-development needs/ goals. On my blog, I share my personal musings and insights about the Alexander Technique, my journey with AT, and how the Alexander Technique can benefit you.

feeds.title: Alexander Technique Portland Blog
feeds.description: Lyra is an artist, performer, and Alexander Technique teacher whose work addresses the quality of the physical experience of our lives. Her work facilitates discovering our bodies and lives as instruments of artistry. Her mission is to provide an accessible and inclusive space to study The Alexander Technique.

feeds.title: Poise and Presence
feeds.description: Reflections on the Intersection of Daily Life and the Alexander Technique.

feeds.title: Alexander Technique Online Blog
feeds.description: Adrian Farrell ia a STAT qualified Alexander Technique Teacher who provides with Alexander Technique lessons in Central London and North London which helps to improve your posture to relieve back pain, RSI and more.

feeds.title: Activate You Alexander Technique for Musicians
feeds.description: Performance Coaching and Alexander Technique in Bristol and Cardiff with a focus on musicians, performers and curing stage fright in everyone. Activate You helps hard-working creative people unravel the physical and mental knots that prevent them from reaching their full potential.

feeds.title: Balance Arts Center Blog
feeds.description: The Balance Arts Center is dedicated to teaching mindfulness and awareness in action though the principles and practices of the Alexander Technique. Learn the Alexander Technique in group and private settings and apply it to any activity. We educate students in the thoughts and fundamental movement patterns that lead to better balance, posture, coordination, strength, and breathing.

feeds.title: The Alexander Technique in Notting Hill & Holland Park, London W11
feeds.description: Nicholas Brandon is dedicated to inspiring, empowering and educating my clients to go beyond their limitations, so they can flourish, thrive and do the things they love to do with ease, poise, passion and confidence.

feeds.title: Active Stillness Active Stillness Blog
feeds.description: Get private lessons, as well as workshops for teachers, teacher trainees, and experienced students.

feeds.title: Jane Clappison Blog
feeds.description: I am Jane - an Alexander Technique Teacher (qualified 2013), Physiotherapist (qualified 1991), CranioSacral Therapist (1998), and Reiki Practitioner. I teach people to change the way they think, via the alexander technique, which gives more choice & indirectly reduces pain and discomfort.
